name: KoboldCpp
tagline: Single-file offline GGUF inference engine with built-in chat, writing, and OpenAI-compatible local API.
real_test_summary: Tested running a quantized 8B GGUF model via the standalone executable with hybrid CPU and GPU layer offloading. Launches directly with an integrated browser UI and local API without Python environment setup.
pros: Single self-contained executable requires no complex Python or Docker installation
Supports hybrid CPU + GPU layer offloading for low-VRAM machines
Includes built-in chat/story UI alongside an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint
cons: Interface looks more utilitarian than modern desktop chat clients
Requires manual GGUF model file downloads from Hugging Face
